researchNotes: Range list from the official site's Shopify products.json feed (EDP, Extrait and Essence products only; attars, body care, gift sets and samples skipped). Notes, family, concentration and perfumer read from each official product page. Man/Woman versions are separate entries as the site lists them. Several pages show both a notes-and-ingredients list and a separate perfume-notes list that disagree slightly (e.g. Overture Woman, Portrayal Woman); where unclear the first list was used, and Portrayal Woman notes were left empty. Release years and accords not stated on pages, so left null/[]. Family is the page's olfactive family label. Perfumer names as extracted from page text.
